It's that time of the year when Congress must pass a bill to fund the government.

Republicans hold a trifecta in the government (they control the House, Senate, and White House), so this is on them.

Let me be clear: Democrats will NOT help them take away health care.

We will NOT support a partisan Republican spending bill that rips away health care from the American people.

Republicans have launched the largest assault on health care in our country's history. How so? Let me explain.

❗️Republicans took Medicaid away from millions of Americans.

❗️They forced hospitals, nursing homes, and health clinics to close.

❗️They did not extend ACA tax credits, so premiums, co-pays, and deductibles will go up for at least 20M people.

But wait, there's more.

❗️$536 billion will be cut from Medicare if Republicans do not act this year.

❗️They've cut funding for  the CDC, NIH, vaccines, and medical research. People are going to die.

Once again, Democrats will NOT help them take away health care.
People will die as a result of Republicans gutting Medicaid, Medicare, and the Affordable Care Act. We're going to hold the line on protecting health care.

Republicans control the White House, the House, and the Senate. As far as I'm concerned it's THEIR responsibility to fund the government. We're supposed to just roll over and leave people without health care? No thanks.

Marjorie Taylor Greene also knows that the GOP has NO plan for health care.

Don't skip this part: "Not a single Republican in leadership talked to us about this or has given us a plan to help Americans deal with their health insurance premiums DOUBLING!!!"
